title: 写每周工作更新，说清完成了什么和为什么
topic: 读 Basecamp 员工手册里的沟通章节，练习写清本周进展和下一步安排。

source.title: How we work
paragraphs: Since we work asynchronously and remotely, it’s important to [radiate information](https://dev.37signals.com/the-radiating-programmer/) about what we’re working on. We have 4 chief mechanisms for doing that.

*What did you work on today?* You’ll be asked this question every afternoon, and you’re [required](https://3.basecamp.com/2914079/buckets/28168307/messages/6796789594) to answer at least twice a week. You should describe what you’re working on and give some context about why you’re working on it or why it’s important.

*What will you be working on this week?* You’ll be asked this question every Monday morning, and you’re [required](https://3.basecamp.com/2914079/buckets/28168307/messages/6796789594) to answer every week.

These 4 mechanisms work together to free individuals and teams to run their days and cycles with confidence and independence. We have six opportunities per year to make big decisions about what to work on, and the rest of the time should chiefly be spent carrying out those short-term plans. By having clear expectations for communication, it’s easier for everyone to build trust in where we’re going and why.
translations: 因为团队以远程和异步方式协作，我们需要持续同步正在做的工作。主要有四种方式。
你今天做了什么？每天下午会有人问这个问题，你每周至少需要回复两次。请说明正在做什么，并补充这项工作的背景，或解释它为什么重要。
你本周准备做什么？每周一早上会有人问这个问题。
这四种方式让个人和团队能更有把握地安排工作、保持自主。清楚的沟通约定也有助于建立对目标和方向的信任。
fullTextParagraphs: Since we work asynchronously and remotely, it’s important to [radiate information](https://dev.37signals.com/the-radiating-programmer/) about what we’re working on. We have 4 chief mechanisms for doing that.

*What did you work on today?* You’ll be asked this question every afternoon, and you’re [required](https://3.basecamp.com/2914079/buckets/28168307/messages/6796789594) to answer at least twice a week. You should describe what you’re working on and give some context about why you’re working on it or why it’s important.

*What will you be working on this week?* You’ll be asked this question every Monday morning, and you’re [required](https://3.basecamp.com/2914079/buckets/28168307/messages/6796789594) to answer every week.

Daily and weekly check-ins are subdivided by department so you’re only subscribed to your team’s answers. You’re of course free to subscribe to other team check-ins, but you’re not obligated to do so if you find it too noisy.

Every team submits a *Kickoff* for the upcoming cycle, and they’re due the second Friday of the cooldown period. Teams use their kickoff to summarize the work they have scheduled for the upcoming cycle.

*Heartbeats* are required of every team, and they’re due on the first Friday of the cooldown period. Teams use their heartbeat to summarize and celebrate the work they completed during the previous cycle, and the work described in the cycle heartbeat should line up (more or less) with the work you scheduled in the cycle kickoff.

These 4 mechanisms work together to free individuals and teams to run their days and cycles with confidence and independence. We have six opportunities per year to make big decisions about what to work on, and the rest of the time should chiefly be spent carrying out those short-term plans. By having clear expectations for communication, it’s easier for everyone to build trust in where we’re going and why.

Heartbeats and Kickoffs are assigned to team leads well in advance of every cycle. Heartbeats, kickoffs, and automatic check-in answers can all be found in the What Works project for the current year.
verifiedFacts: 37signals 员工手册介绍了团队的日常和每周工作更新。
工作更新除了说明做了什么，也要交代背景或重要性。
每周更新用于同步下周重点，并帮助团队理解工作方向。

notes.explain: 补充原因，让同事知道这项工作解决了什么问题。

scenario.title: 同步供应商费用检查进度
english: You reviewed supplier quotes and found two duplicate charges.
Write a weekly update that explains the result and what you will do next week.
chinese: 你检查了供应商报价，发现两项重复费用。
写一条周更新，说明结果和下周的行动。

firstAttempt.prompt: 请给团队写一条英文周更新：说明你本周完成了什么、这项工作为什么重要，以及下周准备推进什么。
firstAttempt.sample: This week, I updated the onboarding emails and tested them with two new customers. This matters because both customers were unsure which documents to submit. Next week, I’ll revise the checklist and ask Support to review it.
firstAttempt.rationale: 让同事看到进度、工作价值和接下来的重点。

words.example: I’ll share the update in our weekly check-in.
words.translation: 我会在每周进度同步里分享更新。

words.example: A sentence of context will help the team understand the request.
words.translation: 补充一句背景能帮助团队理解这项需求。

words.example: My main focus for the upcoming week is the new checklist.
words.translation: 我下周的主要重点是更新清单。

choice.prompt: 哪条周更新最容易让团队理解进度和价值？
options: I did a few things this week. More next week.
This week, I tested the new signup email with three customers. It matters because several users missed the confirmation link. Next week, I’ll revise the message and share it with Support.
I am busy with multiple tasks and will continue working hard.
choice.why: 具体写出做了什么、为什么重要以及下周的重点。

output.prompt: 本周你完成了供应商报价整理，帮助团队发现两项重复费用；下周准备和采购同事确认新报价，并更新预算表。请写一条英文周更新。
output.sample: This week, I organized the supplier quotes and found two duplicate charges. This matters because we can remove the extra costs before approving the budget. Next week, I’ll confirm the new pricing with Procurement and update the budget sheet.
